name: @cucumber/cucumber
description: The official JavaScript implementation of Cucumber.

readme.summary: Excellent onboarding experience with a clear purpose, concise install step, and a complete end-to-end quick-start example, backed by comprehensive linked documentation.
readme.top_issue: No inline troubleshooting content — common setup errors (missing step definitions, Node version issues) are not addressed in the README itself, only via an external community support link.

sentiment.summary: Project shows signs of slow maintenance with open issues dating 2-3 years back and minimal resolution activity, suggesting maintenance capacity challenges or shifting priorities.

red_flags: Some responses are quite technical and might be challenging for beginners to understand fully.
communication.summary: The maintainer responses are generally helpful, clear, and patient. They provide detailed explanations and solutions while being welcoming to new contributors, though some technical depth could benefit from additional simplification for less experienced users.

concerns: Zero commits in past 6 months despite recent activity 4 days ago suggests irregular maintenance
55 open issues with zero closed in past 6 months indicates unresolved problems accumulating
Zero merged PRs in past 6 months suggests no active development or code review
No active contributors in past 6 months implies maintainer activity has ceased
Unknown last release date suggests release process has stalled
positive_signals: Recent commit 4 days ago indicates some level of ongoing attention
No open PRs suggests maintainers are not accepting speculative contributions (defensive posture)
maintenance.summary: Package shows signs of stagnation with zero maintenance activity over 6 months despite a recent isolated commit, accompanied by a growing backlog of unresolved issues.

changelog.summary: The changelog is well-structured and clearly marks breaking changes, but lacks migration guides.

governance.summary: The documentation provides a clear path for contributors to engage and contribute code, indicates multiple maintainers with merge rights, but lacks details on succession planning and decision-making processes.

risk_factors: Publisher 'GitHub Actions' not in maintainers list

analysis_summary.doc_summary: The README is clear and provides a good quick start with examples, but lacks troubleshooting information.
concerns: Docs: No specific section for common problems and solutions.
Community: feature paths of cucumber.js would not be overridden if provide particular feature file in CLI
Communication: Some responses are quite technical and might be challenging for beginners to understand fully.
Supply Chain: Publisher not in maintainers list
highlights: Frequent commits (100 in the past 6 months)
Breaking changes clearly marked in changelog
